title: SLU Habitat for Neighborhood Business Announces Fall 2026 Cohort
summary_en: SLU- HNB, Saint Louis University's program to help small entrepreneurs grow their retail and service businesses in economically-challenged neighborhoods, announces its Fall 2026 cohort.
